normal.threat: Unpatched container runtime vulnerability allowing container breakout
normal.control: Automated vulnerability scanning and monthly rolling OS and node patching
normal.residual_risk: Zero-day vulnerability window before security patch publication

missing_asset.threat: Unauthorized SSH brute-force attack against Linux host
missing_asset.control: Disable password authentication and enforce bastion host with MFA

unrelated_control.threat: Remote buffer overflow vulnerability in unpatched web service
unrelated_control.control: Physical security turnstiles and visitor badge requirements
